_about: The house's own ring images, not Shopify's: AI renders (Nano Banana) of the shop's DSC photographs, padded onto white at 1500px — from iCloud heroes-white-1500 (179 files, see its _REVIEW.txt). heroes: an image put first on a Shopify piece (by handle). pieces: rings known only from these images, no price (Price on request); name, collection, plating and stones were read off the image on 2026-09-23 and may be corrected. also: more images of the same piece; photoPlating: which plating an image shows. held: images deliberately not shown, with the reason. Originals live on the server at /catalog-src/local/<id>.png (never in git). Bangles and bracelets (ids bb-NNN.jpg, 2026-09-23): the photographs in ~/Downloads/House of Mina — Bangles & Bracelets 3.pdf, extracted by their No.; story is that catalogue's description. Its 20 pieces already on Shopify are not repeated.
